def upsert_users_from_csv(path)
	rows = load_csv(path)
	headers = rows[0].map {|s| s.downcase }
#	rows = rows[0..1000]
	rows.each_with_index do |row,idx|
		next if idx == 0
		email = row[2].to_s.downcase
		next unless email.present?

		city = row[5].to_s.titleize
		phone = row[3]
		data = {
			csv: true,
			csv_version: 'disp2',
			name: row[1],
			handle: row[1],
			email: row[2],
			phone: phone,			
			address: row[4],
			city: city,
			state: row[6],
			website: row[7],
			contact: phone,
			license_numbers: row[8],
			type: 'seller'
		}
		
		puts "#{idx}: #{email}, #{city}"
		begin 
			if (user = $users.get(email: email))
				$users.update_id(user[:_id], data)
			else
				data[:_id] = nice_id
				$users.add(data)
			end
		rescue => e 
			puts e.to_s.red
		end
		# 
		# puts "no user for email #{email}" unless user 
		# puts "idx: #{idx}, updating #{email}, user_id: #{$users.get(email: email)[:_id]}"
	end

	puts "done."
end

get '/admin/users.csv' do
  cols  = ['_id', 'email', 'name', 'handle', 'type', 'signup_ip_country', 'ref', 'created_at', 'active_at']
  users = $users.find(adm_users_crit(pr)).sort(created_at: -1).projection(cols.map { |c| [c, 1] }.to_h).to_a
  content_type 'text/csv'
  attachment "users-#{Date.today}.csv"
  cell = ->(v) { v = v.to_s.sub(/\A[=+\-@]/, "'\\0"); '"' + v.gsub('"', '""') + '"' } # quoted, spreadsheet formulas defused
  ([cols] + users.map { |u| cols.map { |c| u[c] } }).map { |row| row.map(&cell).join(',') }.join("\n")
end

def adm_users_crit(params)
  crit = {}
  if (q = params[:q]).present?
    rx   = adm_regex(q)
    crit['$or'] = [{email: rx}, {name: rx}, {handle: rx}, {_id: q.strip}]
  end
  crit[:type] = params[:type] if params[:type].present?
  case params[:filter]
  when 'new'      then crit[:created_at] = {'$gte' => adm_since(7)}
  when 'active'   then crit[:active_at]  = {'$gte' => adm_since(7)}
  when 'inactive' then crit[:active_at]  = {'$not' => {'$gte' => adm_since(30)}}
  end
  crit
end
```

def enroll_user(user_id, cast_id, data = {})
	buyer_id       = user_id
	data[:user_id] = user_id
	data[:cast_id] = cast_id
	data[:status]  = ENROLL_ACTIVE

	if enroll = $enrolls.get(user_id: user_id, cast_id: cast_id)
		$enrolls.update_id(enroll[:_id], data)
	else 
		$enrolls.add(data)
	end	
	
	cast = $casts.get(cast_id)
	if is_pro_cast(cast) 
		user = $users.get(user_id)
		tags = user[:tags].to_s || ''
		### 'payment_cast'
		tags += (cast[:_id])
		# tags = tags.uniq
		$users.update_id(user_id, tags: tags) 
		html = "data: #{data.to_json}, cast_id: #{cast_id}"
		Thread.new { send_email('sella@indydevs.com', "pro purchase: #{buyer_id}"+Time.now.to_s, html) }
	end

	send_enrollment_emails(user_id, cast_id)

	add_user_as_customer(user_id, cast_id)	
rescue => e 
	log_e(e)
end

def send_email(to, subj, html_body, opts = {})
  attachments = opts[:attachments].to_a
  email       = $emails_sent.add(to: to, subj: subj, html_body: html_body, opts: opts, res: EMAILS_ON ? 'sending' : 'unsent')
  
  if EMAILS_ON
    Thread.new {
      begin
        res = $postmark_client.deliver({from: opts[:from] || EMAILS_FROM,
        to: to,
        subject: subj,
        html_body: html_body,

def mongo_coll_keys(coll)
  coll_name = coll.name
  key = "#{coll_name}_collection_fields"  
  if true || !$mongo_data[key]  
    items       = coll.random(50).compact
    keys_count  = {}
    items.each {|item| item.keys.each {|item_key| keys_count[item_key] = (keys_count[item_key] || 0)+1; } }
    keys_count  = keys_count.sort_by {|_key, value| -value}.to_h
    keys        = keys_count.keys
    $mongo_data[key] = keys
  end
  $mongo_data[key]
rescue => e 
  puts "Error in mongo_coll_keys:".red
  puts e.to_s.red
  []
end

def ai_open_agent_chat(user_id, key)
	ai_find_agent_chat(user_id, key) || begin
		chat = $ai_chats.add(user_id: user_id, agent: key, title: "Chat with #{AI_AGENTS[key][:name]}")

sources.label: ai_find_agent_chat
sources.code:
def ai_find_agent_chat(user_id, key)
	agent = key == AI_DEFAULT_AGENT ? {'$in' => [key, nil]} : key # chats from before agents existed are Indy's
	chat, *rest = $ai_chats.find({user_id: user_id, agent: agent}, sort: {created_at: 1}).to_a
	return nil unless chat
	if rest.any?
		$ai_msgs.update_many({chat_id: {'$in' => rest.map {|c| c[:_id] }}}, {'$set' => {chat_id: chat[:_id]}})
		$ai_chats.delete_many(_id: {'$in' => rest.map {|c| c[:_id] }})
	end
	if rest.any? || chat[:agent] != key || chat[:seen_at].nil? # an old chat: what's in it counts as seen
		chat = $ai_chats.update_id(chat[:_id], {agent: key, title: "Chat with #{AI_AGENTS[key][:name]}", seen_at: chat[:seen_at] || Time.now})
	end
	chat
end

def ai_public_msg(msg)
	res = {role: msg[:role], text: msg[:text], at: msg[:created_at] && msg[:created_at].iso8601(3)}
	res[:platform] = msg[:platform] if msg[:platform] # msgs of agents reachable on several platforms (bl/pablo.rb)
	res[:sender]   = msg[:sender]   if msg[:sender]
	res[:delivery] = msg[:delivery] if msg[:delivery] # 'sent' / 'failed: <why>' / 'off' - for msgs sent out on that platform
	res
end

def ai_sidebar(user_id)
	ai_team.map do |key, a|
		chat = ai_find_agent_chat(user_id, key)
		last = chat && $ai_msgs.find({chat_id: chat[:_id]}, sort: {created_at: -1}, limit: 1).first
		{
			key: key, name: a[:name], dept: a[:dept], role: a[:role], color: a[:color], suggestions: a[:suggestions],

		}
	end
end

  send_email('sella.rafaeli@gmail.com',subj,body)
end

sources.code:
def send_email(to, subj, html_body, opts = {})
  attachments = opts[:attachments].to_a
  email       = $emails_sent.add(to: to, subj: subj, html_body: html_body, opts: opts, res: EMAILS_ON ? 'sending' : 'unsent')
  
  if EMAILS_ON
    Thread.new {
      begin
        res = $postmark_client.deliver({from: opts[:from] || EMAILS_FROM,
        to: to,
        subject: subj,
        html_body: html_body,
        Attachments: attachments,     
        reply_to: opts[:reply_to], # optional
        track_opens: true,
        message_stream: opts[:message_stream] || 'broadcast'}.compact)
        $emails_sent.update_id(email[:_id], res: 'sent', postmark_id: (res[:message_id] rescue nil))
        puts "sent email: #{res}"
      rescue => e # surfaces on /admin/emails and /admin/errors
        $emails_sent.update_id(email[:_id], res: 'failed', error: e.to_s)
        log_e(e)
      end
    }
  else 
    puts "Skipping email subject: #{subj} because !EMAILS_ON".red    
  end

  email
rescue => e
  puts e.to_s.red
  log_e(e)
  false
end

def ai_open_agent_chat(user_id, key)
	ai_find_agent_chat(user_id, key) || begin
		chat = $ai_chats.add(user_id: user_id, agent: key, title: "Chat with #{AI_AGENTS[key][:name]}")

sources.label: ai_find_agent_chat
sources.code:
def ai_find_agent_chat(user_id, key)
	agent = key == AI_DEFAULT_AGENT ? {'$in' => [key, nil]} : key # chats from before agents existed are Indy's
	chat, *rest = $ai_chats.find({user_id: user_id, agent: agent}, sort: {created_at: 1}).to_a
	return nil unless chat
	if rest.any?
		$ai_msgs.update_many({chat_id: {'$in' => rest.map {|c| c[:_id] }}}, {'$set' => {chat_id: chat[:_id]}})
		$ai_chats.delete_many(_id: {'$in' => rest.map {|c| c[:_id] }})
	end
	if rest.any? || chat[:agent] != key || chat[:seen_at].nil? # an old chat: what's in it counts as seen
		chat = $ai_chats.update_id(chat[:_id], {agent: key, title: "Chat with #{AI_AGENTS[key][:name]}", seen_at: chat[:seen_at] || Time.now})
	end
	chat
end

def ai_public_msg(msg)
	res = {role: msg[:role], text: msg[:text], at: msg[:created_at] && msg[:created_at].iso8601(3)}
	res[:platform] = msg[:platform] if msg[:platform] # msgs of agents reachable on several platforms (bl/pablo.rb)
	res[:sender]   = msg[:sender]   if msg[:sender]
	res[:delivery] = msg[:delivery] if msg[:delivery] # 'sent' / 'failed: <why>' / 'off' - for msgs sent out on that platform
	res
end

def ai_sidebar(user_id)
	ai_team.map do |key, a|
		chat = ai_find_agent_chat(user_id, key)
		last = chat && $ai_msgs.find({chat_id: chat[:_id]}, sort: {created_at: -1}, limit: 1).first
		{
			key: key, name: a[:name], dept: a[:dept], role: a[:role], color: a[:color], suggestions: a[:suggestions],
			last:   last ? ai_public_msg(last).merge(text: last[:text].to_s[0, 300]) : {role: 'assistant', text: a[:hello], at: nil},
			unread: chat ? ai_unread_count(chat) : 1,
		}
	end
end

	chat

def ai_stream_reply(chat, me, user_msg, messages, reply_fields = {}, &on_saved)
	agent = ai_chat_agent(chat)
	ai_stream_events do |emit|
		reply = +''
		error = nil
		begin
			emit.(type: 'start', at: user_msg[:created_at].iso8601(3))
			$ai_openai.chat(parameters: {
				model:    AI_MODEL,
				messages: messages,
				max_tokens: AI_MAX_REPLY_TOKENS,
				stream:   proc do |chunk, _bytesize|
					delta = chunk.dig('choices', 0, 'delta', 'content')
					next if delta.nil? || delta.empty? # not .present? - a delta is often just "\n" or " "
					reply << delta
					emit.(type: 'delta', text: delta)
				end
			})
			error = 'No reply came back - please try again.' if reply.empty?
		rescue => e
			log_e(e)
			error = $prod ? 'Sorry, something went wrong. Please try again.' : "AI error: #{e.message}"
		end

		if reply.present? # keep whatever was generated, also when an error cut it short
			saved = $ai_msgs.add(reply_fields.merge(chat_id: chat[:_id], role: 'assistant', text: reply, model: AI_MODEL))
			$ai_chats.update_id(chat[:_id], {})
			Thread.new { paamonim_update_family(me[:_id]) } if agent[:family_file]
			extra = (on_saved.call(saved) rescue log_e($!)) if on_saved
		else # nothing came back: don't leave an unanswered msg in the history (the browser hands the text back for a resend)
			$ai_msgs.delete_one(_id: user_msg[:_id])
		end
		# sent only once the reply is saved, so the browser's "seen" can't land before it
		emit.(error ? {type: 'error', msg: error, retry: reply.empty?} : {type: 'done', at: saved[:created_at].iso8601(3)}.merge(extra.is_a?(Hash) ? extra : {}))
	end
end

def ai_stream_events
	content_type 'application/x-ndjson'
	headers 'Transfer-Encoding' => 'chunked', 'Cache-Control' => 'no-cache', 'X-Accel-Buffering' => 'no'

	stream do |out|
		gone = false # the browser went away: stop writing, but let the caller finish its work
		emit = lambda do |event|
			next if gone
			data = event.to_json + "\n"
			begin
				out << "#{data.bytesize.to_s(16)}\r\n#{data}\r\n"
			rescue
				gone = true
			end
		end
		begin
			yield emit
		ensure
			(out << "0\r\n\r\n") rescue nil
		end
	end
end

def paamonim_update_family(user_id)
	$paamonim_family_lock.synchronize do
		chats = paamonim_family_chats(user_id)
		msgs  = paamonim_family_msgs(user_id, chats)
		next if msgs.empty?

		user = $users.get(user_id) || {}
		base = {
			user_id:      user_id,
			email:        user[:email],
			account_name: CGI.unescapeHTML((user[:name] || user[:handle]).to_s).squish.presence,
			chats_count:  chats.count,
			msgs_count:   msgs.count,
			last_msg_at:  msgs.last[:created_at],
		}
		family = $paamonim_families.get(user_id)
		family = family ? $paamonim_families.update_id(user_id, base) : $paamonim_families.add(base.merge(_id: user_id))

		current = PAAMONIM_FIELDS.keys.to_h {|k| [k, family[k]] }
		current.merge!(attention_resolved_at: family[:attention_resolved_at], last_attention_reason: family[:last_attention_reason]) if family[:attention_resolved_at]
		lines = msgs.last(PAAMONIM_TRANSCRIPT_MSGS).map do |m|
			"[#{m[:created_at].strftime('%Y-%m-%d %H:%M')}] #{m[:role] == 'user' ? 'family' : 'assistant'}: #{m[:text].to_s[0, 2000]}"
		end

		res = $ai_openai.chat(parameters: {
			model:           AI_MODEL,
			response_format: {type: 'json_object'},
			temperature:     0.2,
			max_tokens:      1500,
			messages: [
				{role: 'system', content: PAAMONIM_FAMILY_PROMPT},
				{role: 'user',   content: "Current file:\n#{current.to_json}\n\nConversation, oldest first:\n\n#{lines.join("\n\n")}"},
			]
		})
		fields = paamonim_clean_file(JSON.parse(res.dig('choices', 0, 'message', 'content').to_s)) rescue nil
		next unless fields

		fields[:attention_reason] = nil unless fields[:needs_attention]
		fields[:attention_at]     = Time.now if fields[:needs_attention] && !family[:needs_attention] # newly flagged
		$paamonim_families.update_id(user_id, fields.merge(ai_updated_at: Time.now, model: AI_MODEL))
	end
rescue => e
	log_e(e)
end

def paamonim_clean_file(raw)
	raw = {} unless raw.is_a?(Hash)
	str = ->(v, max) { (v.is_a?(String) || v.is_a?(Numeric)) ? v.to_s.squish[0, max].presence : nil }
	int = ->(v) { s = v.to_s.delete(',₪ ').strip; s =~ /\A-?\d+(\.\d+)?\z/ ? s.to_f.round : nil }
	PAAMONIM_FIELDS.to_h do |key, type|
		v = raw[key.to_s]
		val = case type
			when :str   then str.(v, 600)
			when :int   then int.(v)
			when :ints  then Array(v).map {|x| int.(x) }.compact.first(20)
			when :list  then Array(v).map {|x| str.(x, 200) }.compact.first(15)
			when :bool  then v == true || v.to_s == 'true'
			when Array  then type.include?(v.to_s) ? v.to_s : type.first
		end
		[key, val]
	end
end

def ai_find_agent_chat(user_id, key)
	agent = key == AI_DEFAULT_AGENT ? {'$in' => [key, nil]} : key # chats from before agents existed are Indy's
	chat, *rest = $ai_chats.find({user_id: user_id, agent: agent}, sort: {created_at: 1}).to_a
	return nil unless chat
	if rest.any?
		$ai_msgs.update_many({chat_id: {'$in' => rest.map {|c| c[:_id] }}}, {'$set' => {chat_id: chat[:_id]}})
		$ai_chats.delete_many(_id: {'$in' => rest.map {|c| c[:_id] }})
	end
	if rest.any? || chat[:agent] != key || chat[:seen_at].nil? # an old chat: what's in it counts as seen
		chat = $ai_chats.update_id(chat[:_id], {agent: key, title: "Chat with #{AI_AGENTS[key][:name]}", seen_at: chat[:seen_at] || Time.now})
	end
	chat
end

def ai_stream_reply(chat, me, user_msg, messages, reply_fields = {}, &on_saved)
	agent = ai_chat_agent(chat)
	ai_stream_events do |emit|
		reply = +''
		error = nil
		begin
			emit.(type: 'start', at: user_msg[:created_at].iso8601(3))
			$ai_openai.chat(parameters: {
				model:    AI_MODEL,
				messages: messages,
				max_tokens: AI_MAX_REPLY_TOKENS,
				stream:   proc do |chunk, _bytesize|
					delta = chunk.dig('choices', 0, 'delta', 'content')
					next if delta.nil? || delta.empty? # not .present? - a delta is often just "\n" or " "
					reply << delta
					emit.(type: 'delta', text: delta)
				end
			})
			error = 'No reply came back - please try again.' if reply.empty?
		rescue => e
			log_e(e)
			error = $prod ? 'Sorry, something went wrong. Please try again.' : "AI error: #{e.message}"
		end

		if reply.present? # keep whatever was generated, also when an error cut it short
			saved = $ai_msgs.add(reply_fields.merge(chat_id: chat[:_id], role: 'assistant', text: reply, model: AI_MODEL))
			$ai_chats.update_id(chat[:_id], {})
			Thread.new { paamonim_update_family(me[:_id]) } if agent[:family_file]
			extra = (on_saved.call(saved) rescue log_e($!)) if on_saved
		else # nothing came back: don't leave an unanswered msg in the history (the browser hands the text back for a resend)
			$ai_msgs.delete_one(_id: user_msg[:_id])
		end
		# sent only once the reply is saved, so the browser's "seen" can't land before it
		emit.(error ? {type: 'error', msg: error, retry: reply.empty?} : {type: 'done', at: saved[:created_at].iso8601(3)}.merge(extra.is_a?(Hash) ? extra : {}))
	end
end
```

def ai_stream_events
	content_type 'application/x-ndjson'
	headers 'Transfer-Encoding' => 'chunked', 'Cache-Control' => 'no-cache', 'X-Accel-Buffering' => 'no'

	stream do |out|
		gone = false # the browser went away: stop writing, but let the caller finish its work
		emit = lambda do |event|
			next if gone
			data = event.to_json + "\n"
			begin
				out << "#{data.bytesize.to_s(16)}\r\n#{data}\r\n"
			rescue
				gone = true
			end
		end
		begin
			yield emit
		ensure
			(out << "0\r\n\r\n") rescue nil
		end
	end
end

def paamonim_update_family(user_id)
	$paamonim_family_lock.synchronize do
		chats = paamonim_family_chats(user_id)
		msgs  = paamonim_family_msgs(user_id, chats)
		next if msgs.empty?

		user = $users.get(user_id) || {}
		base = {
			user_id:      user_id,
			email:        user[:email],
			account_name: CGI.unescapeHTML((user[:name] || user[:handle]).to_s).squish.presence,
			chats_count:  chats.count,
			msgs_count:   msgs.count,
			last_msg_at:  msgs.last[:created_at],
		}
		family = $paamonim_families.get(user_id)
		family = family ? $paamonim_families.update_id(user_id, base) : $paamonim_families.add(base.merge(_id: user_id))

		current = PAAMONIM_FIELDS.keys.to_h {|k| [k, family[k]] }
		current.merge!(attention_resolved_at: family[:attention_resolved_at], last_attention_reason: family[:last_attention_reason]) if family[:attention_resolved_at]
		lines = msgs.last(PAAMONIM_TRANSCRIPT_MSGS).map do |m|
			"[#{m[:created_at].strftime('%Y-%m-%d %H:%M')}] #{m[:role] == 'user' ? 'family' : 'assistant'}: #{m[:text].to_s[0, 2000]}"
		end

		res = $ai_openai.chat(parameters: {
			model:           AI_MODEL,
			response_format: {type: 'json_object'},
			temperature:     0.2,
			max_tokens:      1500,
			messages: [
				{role: 'system', content: PAAMONIM_FAMILY_PROMPT},
				{role: 'user',   content: "Current file:\n#{current.to_json}\n\nConversation, oldest first:\n\n#{lines.join("\n\n")}"},
			]
		})
		fields = paamonim_clean_file(JSON.parse(res.dig('choices', 0, 'message', 'content').to_s)) rescue nil
		next unless fields

		fields[:attention_reason] = nil unless fields[:needs_attention]
		fields[:attention_at]     = Time.now if fields[:needs_attention] && !family[:needs_attention] # newly flagged
		$paamonim_families.update_id(user_id, fields.merge(ai_updated_at: Time.now, model: AI_MODEL))
	end
rescue => e
	log_e(e)
end

def paamonim_family_context(user_id)
	family = $paamonim_families.get(user_id)
	return "\nThis family is new: you have no file on them yet. Welcome them and start onboarding.\n" unless family && family[:ai_updated_at]

	known = (PAAMONIM_FIELDS.keys - [:missing, :needs_attention, :attention_reason, :next_step]).to_h {|k| [k, family[k]] }
	known.reject! {|_, v| v.blank? }
	text  = "\nWhat you already know about this family, from your conversations so far (also earlier chats) - don't ask again what you already know:\n#{known.to_json}\n"
	text += "Still missing for onboarding: #{family[:missing].join(', ')}. Find a natural moment to ask.\n" if family[:missing].present?
	text
end

sources.code:
def send_email(to, subj, html_body, opts = {})
  attachments = opts[:attachments].to_a
  email       = $emails_sent.add(to: to, subj: subj, html_body: html_body, opts: opts, res: EMAILS_ON ? 'sending' : 'unsent')
  
  if EMAILS_ON
    Thread.new {
      begin
        res = $postmark_client.deliver({from: opts[:from] || EMAILS_FROM,
        to: to,
        subject: subj,
        html_body: html_body,
        Attachments: attachments,     
        reply_to: opts[:reply_to], # optional
        track_opens: true,
        message_stream: opts[:message_stream] || 'broadcast'}.compact)
        $emails_sent.update_id(email[:_id], res: 'sent', postmark_id: (res[:message_id] rescue nil))
        puts "sent email: #{res}"
      rescue => e # surfaces on /admin/emails and /admin/errors
        $emails_sent.update_id(email[:_id], res: 'failed', error: e.to_s)
        log_e(e)
      end
    }
  else 
    puts "Skipping email subject: #{subj} because !EMAILS_ON".red    
  end

  email
rescue => e
  puts e.to_s.red
  log_e(e)
  false
end

post '/casts/edit/:id' do	
	id   = pr[:id]

	CAST_AMENITIES_NAMES.to_a.each { |name| pr[name] ||= false }

	if id == 'new' 
		new_cast = add_new_cast
		id = new_cast[:_id]
	else 
		require_cast_owner(id)
	end


	pr[:media] = []
	pr[:media_img].to_a.each_with_index { |url, idx| pr[:media].push({type: pr[:media_types][idx], url: url}) }

	data = pr.just_keys(CAST_FIELDS)
	
	data.delete(:tags) unless is_admin

	[:zcost_dollars, :hour, :mins, :length].each { |k| data[k] = data[k].to_i if data[k].present? }

	# puts data

	# data[:user_id] = cuid

	[:datetime].each                  { |f| data[f] = DateTime.parse(pr[f]) if data[f].present? }
	[:series_start, :series_end].each { |f| data[f] = Date.parse(pr[f])     if data[f].present? }
	
	pr[:tags] = pr[:tags].to_s.split(',').map(&:strip)
	$casts.update_id(id, data)
	
	# cache casts on cu
	cu[:casts]     = cu[:casts] || {}
	cu[:casts][id] = data
	$users.update_id(cuid,{casts:cu[:casts]})
	
	if pr[:ajax] 
		{msg: 'ok'}
	else 
		flash.message = 'Updated.'
		redirect '/casts/edit/'+id
		 #redirect "/me?sec=by_me"
	end
end

	#optimistic_msg = {id: 'mock'+Time.now.to_s, user_id: cuid, img_url: cu[:img_url], type: cu[:type], name: cu[:name], msg: pr[:msg], created_at: Time.now}
	
	#html = erb :'chat/single_chat_msg', locals: {msg: optimistic_msg}
		#bp
	# Thread.new {	
		my_id = cuid
		if !cu && (email = pr[:email]).present? #allow signup-on-first-msg by sending pr[:email]=...
			if $users.get(email: email)
				halt(200,{err: 'Email taken. Perhaps try to log in?', goto: "/login?email=#{email}&go_back_to=#{pr[:go_back_to]}"})
			else 
				add_user
				new_user = $users.get(email: email)
				session[:user_id] = my_id = new_user[:_id]
			end
		end

		if pr[:user_chat]
			cast = ensure_chat_exists(my_id, pr[:target_id])
		else 
			#cast = $casts.get(pr[:cast_id])
			cast_id = id = pr[:cast_id]
			#cast = {_id: id, zipcode: id}.hwia
			post = $posts.get(cast_id)
			cast = post || {_id: cast_id}.hwia #plain rooms (e.g. /chat => 'home') have no post behind them
		end
		post ||= {}

		user = $users.get(my_id)
		halt(401, {err: 'Please sign up or log in first.'}) unless user
			
		data = {cast_id: cast[:_id], 
			user_id: user[:_id], 
			name: user[:name] || user[:handle], 
			img_url: user[:img_url],
			title: user[:title],
			type: pr[:type], 
			message: pr[:msg], 
			status: CHAT_MSG_OK,
			thread_title: post[:title],
			thread_creator: (post[:user] || {})[:name]
			#html: html
		}

		#bp

		data[:msg_body_img] = pr[:msg_body_img] if pr[:msg_body_img].present?
		data[:address] = user[:address] if user[:address].present?
		data[:contact] = user[:contact] if user[:contact].present?
		data[:website] = user[:website] if user[:website].present?

		data[:parent_msg_id] = pr[:parent_msg_id] if pr[:parent_msg_id].present?
		#data[:total]   = $chat_msgs.count(cast_id: cast[:_id])

		if cast[silenced_key(user[:_id])]
			# halt(401, {err: 'You have been silenced :('})
		end

		type = pr[:type] || 'new-msg'

		#if type == 'rtc-offer' || type == 'rtc-answer' || type == 'rtc-start' || type == 'rtc-ice-candidate'
		if type.to_s.include?('webrtc') || type == 'newHTML'
			data = data.merge(pr) #send the rtc-desc (offer/answer)
		else 
			$chat.add(data) 
		end

		if is_chat_cast(cast)
			other_user_id = chat_cast_ouid(cast)
			$casts.update_id(cast[:_id], "last_msg_for_#{other_user_id}" => Time.now)
		end
		
		data[:all_channels_last_day] = $all_channels_data

		Thread.new {
			$pusher.trigger(cast_chat_channel(cast), type, data)	
			send_email('sella@indydevs.com', "new comment"+data.to_json, "new comment"+data.to_json)
			#send_email('kfir@indydevs.com', "new indydevs comment"+data.to_json, "new comment"+data.to_json)
		}

		if pr[:redirect_back]
			flash.message = 'Thank you!'
			redirect back
		end

		{res: 'ok'}
	# }	

	#return {html: html}
end

def send_email(to, subj, html_body, opts = {})
  attachments = opts[:attachments].to_a
  email       = $emails_sent.add(to: to, subj: subj, html_body: html_body, opts: opts, res: EMAILS_ON ? 'sending' : 'unsent')
  
  if EMAILS_ON
    Thread.new {
      begin
        res = $postmark_client.deliver({from: opts[:from] || EMAILS_FROM,
        to: to,
        subject: subj,
        html_body: html_body,
        Attachments: attachments,     
        reply_to: opts[:reply_to], # optional
        track_opens: true,
        message_stream: opts[:message_stream] || 'broadcast'}.compact)
        $emails_sent.update_id(email[:_id], res: 'sent', postmark_id: (res[:message_id] rescue nil))
        puts "sent email: #{res}"
      rescue => e # surfaces on /admin/emails and /admin/errors
        $emails_sent.update_id(email[:_id], res: 'failed', error: e.to_s)
        log_e(e)
      end
    }
  else 
    puts "Skipping email subject: #{subj} because !EMAILS_ON".red    
  end

  email
rescue => e
  puts e.to_s.red
  log_e(e)
  false
end

def log_e(err, data = {})  
    err = {msg: err.to_s, backtrace: err.backtrace.to_a.slice(0,100)} if err.is_a? Exception
    err = {msg: err} unless err.is_a? Hash
    err[:user_id]  = cuid rescue 'nil'

    err[:path]     = request_path rescue 'no-path'
    err[:params]   = JSON.parse(_params.to_json) rescue {} #sometimes params has un-BSON able fields
    $errors.add(err)
  rescue => e
    puts e
  end

sources.code:
def send_email(to, subj, html_body, opts = {})
  attachments = opts[:attachments].to_a
  email       = $emails_sent.add(to: to, subj: subj, html_body: html_body, opts: opts, res: EMAILS_ON ? 'sending' : 'unsent')
  
  if EMAILS_ON
    Thread.new {
      begin
        res = $postmark_client.deliver({from: opts[:from] || EMAILS_FROM,
        to: to,
        subject: subj,
        html_body: html_body,
        Attachments: attachments,     
        reply_to: opts[:reply_to], # optional
        track_opens: true,
        message_stream: opts[:message_stream] || 'broadcast'}.compact)
        $emails_sent.update_id(email[:_id], res: 'sent', postmark_id: (res[:message_id] rescue nil))
        puts "sent email: #{res}"
      rescue => e # surfaces on /admin/emails and /admin/errors
        $emails_sent.update_id(email[:_id], res: 'failed', error: e.to_s)
        log_e(e)
      end
    }
  else 
    puts "Skipping email subject: #{subj} because !EMAILS_ON".red    
  end

  email
rescue => e
  puts e.to_s.red
  log_e(e)
  false
end

def cancel_enroll(enroll)
	$enrolls.update_id(enroll[:_id], canceled_at: Time.now, status: ENROLL_CANCELED)
	if (stripe_sub_id = enroll[:sub_id] || enroll[:stripe_sub_id])
		cancel_stripe_sub(stripe_sub_id)
	end

	cast = $casts.get(enroll[:cast_id]) 
	if (cast && cast[:tags].to_s.include?(NOWCAST_PRO))
		$users.update_one({_id: cuid}, {'$unset': {NOWCAST_PRO => 1}})
	end
rescue => e
	log_e(e)
	false
end

def send_email(to, subj, html_body, opts = {})
  attachments = opts[:attachments].to_a
  email       = $emails_sent.add(to: to, subj: subj, html_body: html_body, opts: opts, res: EMAILS_ON ? 'sending' : 'unsent')
  
  if EMAILS_ON
    Thread.new {
      begin
        res = $postmark_client.deliver({from: opts[:from] || EMAILS_FROM,
        to: to,
        subject: subj,
        html_body: html_body,
        Attachments: attachments,     
        reply_to: opts[:reply_to], # optional
        track_opens: true,
        message_stream: opts[:message_stream] || 'broadcast'}.compact)
        $emails_sent.update_id(email[:_id], res: 'sent', postmark_id: (res[:message_id] rescue nil))
        puts "sent email: #{res}"
      rescue => e # surfaces on /admin/emails and /admin/errors
        $emails_sent.update_id(email[:_id], res: 'failed', error: e.to_s)
        log_e(e)
      end
    }
  else 
    puts "Skipping email subject: #{subj} because !EMAILS_ON".red    
  end

  email

  attachments = opts[:attachments].to_a
  email       = $emails_sent.add(to: to, subj: subj, html_body: html_body, opts: opts, res: EMAILS_ON ? 'sending' : 'unsent')

      end
    }
  else

post '/casts/game/move/:cast_id' do 
	require_user
	# a: update game state 
	cast_id = pr[:cast_id]
	game    = get_cast_game(cast_id) # {board: ..., users: {abc: {}}}

	board   = game[:board]
	game_users = game[:users]

	game_users[cuid]           = (game_users[cuid] || {}).merge(clean_user(cu))

	current_user_location = game_users[cuid][:location] || [rand(board.size),rand(board.size)]

	x = current_user_location[0]
	y = current_user_location[1]
	
	move = pr[:move]

	x = x-1 if move == 'up' 
	x = x+1 if move == 'down' 
	y = y-1 if move == 'left'  	
	y = y+1 if move == 'right'

	if (x>=0) && (x<board.size) && (x<board[0].size) && (y>=0) && (y<board.size) && (y<board[0].size)
		game_users[cuid][:location] = [x,y]
	end
	
	$games.update_id(game[:_id], users: game_users)
	# b: notify via pusher all game viewers

	return {cast_id: pr[:cast_id], move: move, game: $games.get(game[:_id])}
end

get '/google_redirect_uri' do
  # Step 2: Handle the OAuth 2.0 server response
  code = CGI.unescapeHTML params[:code]

  # Step 3: Exchange authorization code for access token
  uri = URI('https://oauth2.googleapis.com/token')
  res = Net::HTTP.post_form(uri, {
    'code' => code,
    'client_id' => CLIENT_ID,
    'client_secret' => CLIENT_SECRET,
    'redirect_uri' => REDIRECT_URI,
    'grant_type' => 'authorization_code'
  })

  response_body = JSON.parse(res.body)
  access_token  = response_body['access_token']

  # Step 4: Use the access token to access the user's profile information
  uri = URI('https://www.googleapis.com/oauth2/v1/userinfo?alt=json')
  req = Net::HTTP::Get.new(uri)
  req['Authorization'] = "Bearer #{access_token}"

  res = Net::HTTP.start(uri.hostname, uri.port, use_ssl: uri.scheme == 'https') do |http|
    http.request(req)
  end

  user_info = JSON.parse(res.body).hwia

  email = user_info[:email]

  user  = $users.get(email: email) 
  if user 
  	session[:user_id] = user[:_id]
  else 
    data = {email: email, from_google_auth: 'yes'}
  	user = $users.add(data)
  	session[:user_id] = user[:_id]
  end

  $users.update_id(user[:_id], img_url: user_info[:picture], last_login: Time.now) if user_info[:picture].present? 
  $users.update_id(user[:_id], name: user_info[:name]) if user[:name].blank? && user_info[:name].present?
  
  # Display the user's profile information
  # redirect '/me'
  redirect(session.delete(:after_login) || '/') # e.g. /haifacity/login sends people back to /haifacity
  # redirect '/hoffa'
  #"Hello, #{user_info['name']} (#{user_info['email']})"
end

post '/haifacity/group/msgs' do
	require_user_ajax
	me   = cu
	text = haifacity_input_text(HAIFACITY_MAX_GROUP_CHARS)
	halt_bad_input(msg: hc_t(:err_empty)) unless text.present?
	halt(429, {msg: hc_t(:err_muted)}) if haifacity_muted?(me[:_id])
	if $haifacity_msgs.count_documents(user_id: me[:_id], created_at: {'$gt': 1.minute.ago}) >= HAIFACITY_GROUP_RATE
		halt(429, {msg: hc_t(:err_slow)})
	end

	fields  = {role: 'user', user_id: me[:_id], name: haifacity_display_name(me), text: text}
	flagged = haifacity_flagged_categories(text)
	if flagged.any? # never goes public; kept for the moderation log and strike count
		$haifacity_msgs.add(fields.merge(status: 'blocked', reason: flagged.join(', '), removed_by: 'moderation'))
		halt(422, {msg: hc_t(:err_blocked)})
	end

	msg = haifacity_add_group_msg(fields)
	Thread.new { haifacity_triage(msg[:_id]) }
	{msg: haifacity_public_msg(msg)}
end

def haifacity_triage(msg_id)
	$haifacity_triage_lock.synchronize do
		msg = $haifacity_msgs.get(msg_id)
		next unless msg && msg[:status] == 'ok'

		lines = haifacity_group_msgs(HAIFACITY_GROUP_CONTEXT).map do |m|
			who = m[:role] == 'agent' ? "#{HAIFACITY_AGENT_NAME} (you)" : m[:name]
			"#{m[:_id] == msg_id ? 'NEW ' : ''}#{who}: #{m[:text]}"
		end

		res = $ai_openai.chat(parameters: {
			model: AI_MODEL,
			response_format: {type: 'json_object'},
			max_tokens: AI_MAX_REPLY_TOKENS,
			messages: [
				{role: 'system', content: HAIFACITY_TRIAGE_PROMPT},
				{role: 'user',   content: "Group conversation, oldest first:\n\n#{lines.join("\n")}"}
			]
		})
		decision = JSON.parse(res.dig('choices', 0, 'message', 'content').to_s) rescue {}
		action   = decision['action'].to_s
		reply    = decision['reply'].to_s.strip
		rule     = decision['broken_rule'].to_s
		if action == 'remove' && !HAIFACITY_RULES.key?(rule) # no named rule broken: keep the msg, and drop the "I removed..." note too
			action, reply = 'none', ''
		end

		if action == 'remove'
			$haifacity_msgs.update_id(msg_id, {status: 'removed', rule: rule, reason: decision['reason'].to_s, removed_by: 'agent'})
			haifacity_broadcast('removed', {id: msg_id})
		end
		if (action == 'remove' || action == 'reply') && reply.present?
			haifacity_add_group_msg(role: 'agent', name: HAIFACITY_AGENT_NAME, text: reply, reply_to: msg_id, model: AI_MODEL)
		end
	end
rescue => e
	log_e(e)
end

def haifacity_triage(msg_id)
	$haifacity_triage_lock.synchronize do
		msg = $haifacity_msgs.get(msg_id)
		next unless msg && msg[:status] == 'ok'

		lines = haifacity_group_msgs(HAIFACITY_GROUP_CONTEXT).map do |m|
			who = m[:role] == 'agent' ? "#{HAIFACITY_AGENT_NAME} (you)" : m[:name]
			"#{m[:_id] == msg_id ? 'NEW ' : ''}#{who}: #{m[:text]}"
		end

		res = $ai_openai.chat(parameters: {
			model: AI_MODEL,
			response_format: {type: 'json_object'},
			max_tokens: AI_MAX_REPLY_TOKENS,
			messages: [
				{role: 'system', content: HAIFACITY_TRIAGE_PROMPT},
				{role: 'user',   content: "Group conversation, oldest first:\n\n#{lines.join("\n")}"}
			]
		})
		decision = JSON.parse(res.dig('choices', 0, 'message', 'content').to_s) rescue {}
		action   = decision['action'].to_s
		reply    = decision['reply'].to_s.strip
		rule     = decision['broken_rule'].to_s
		if action == 'remove' && !HAIFACITY_RULES.key?(rule) # no named rule broken: keep the msg, and drop the "I removed..." note too
			action, reply = 'none', ''
		end

		if action == 'remove'
			$haifacity_msgs.update_id(msg_id, {status: 'removed', rule: rule, reason: decision['reason'].to_s, removed_by: 'agent'})
			haifacity_broadcast('removed', {id: msg_id})
		end
		if (action == 'remove' || action == 'reply') && reply.present?
			haifacity_add_group_msg(role: 'agent', name: HAIFACITY_AGENT_NAME, text: reply, reply_to: msg_id, model: AI_MODEL)
		end
	end
rescue => e
	log_e(e)
end

post '/haifacity/ai/msgs' do
	require_user_ajax
	me   = cu
	text = haifacity_input_text(AI_MAX_MSG_CHARS)
	halt_bad_input(msg: hc_t(:err_empty)) unless text.present?
	if $haifacity_dms.count_documents(user_id: me[:_id], role: 'user', created_at: {'$gt': AI_RATE_WINDOW.ago}) >= AI_RATE_LIMIT
		halt(429, {msg: hc_t(:err_fast)})
	end

	user_msg = $haifacity_dms.add(user_id: me[:_id], role: 'user', text: text)
	messages = haifacity_dm_messages(me)

	ai_stream_events do |emit|
		reply = +''
		begin
			emit.(type: 'start')
			$ai_openai.chat(parameters: {
				model:      AI_MODEL,
				messages:   messages,
				max_tokens: AI_MAX_REPLY_TOKENS,
				stream:     proc do |chunk, _bytesize|
					delta = chunk.dig('choices', 0, 'delta', 'content')
					next if delta.nil? || delta.empty?
					reply << delta
					emit.(type: 'delta', text: delta)
				end
			})
			emit.(type: 'done')
		rescue => e
			log_e(e)
			err = $prod ? hc_t(:err_generic) : "AI error: #{e.message}"
			emit.(type: 'error', msg: err, retry: reply.empty?) rescue nil
		ensure
			if reply.present?
				$haifacity_dms.add(user_id: me[:_id], role: 'assistant', text: reply, model: AI_MODEL)
			else
				$haifacity_dms.delete_one(_id: user_msg[:_id]) # unanswered: the browser hands the text back for a resend
			end
		end
	end
end

def haifacity_display_name(user)
	name  = CGI.unescapeHTML((user[:name].presence || user[:handle]).to_s).squish # user fields are stored html-escaped
	name  = user[:email].to_s.split('@').first.to_s.split(/[._\-+]+/).map(&:capitalize).join(' ') if name.blank? # google sign-ups may only have an email
	parts = name.split(' ')
	return 'guest' if parts.empty?
	parts.size > 1 ? "#{parts.first} #{parts.last[0]}." : parts.first # the group is public: first name + initial
end

def ai_stream_events
	content_type 'application/x-ndjson'
	headers 'Transfer-Encoding' => 'chunked', 'Cache-Control' => 'no-cache', 'X-Accel-Buffering' => 'no'

	stream do |out|
		gone = false # the browser went away: stop writing, but let the caller finish its work
		emit = lambda do |event|
			next if gone
			data = event.to_json + "\n"
			begin
				out << "#{data.bytesize.to_s(16)}\r\n#{data}\r\n"
			rescue
				gone = true
			end
		end
		begin
			yield emit
		ensure
			(out << "0\r\n\r\n") rescue nil
		end
	end
end

def ai_stream_events
	content_type 'application/x-ndjson'
	headers 'Transfer-Encoding' => 'chunked', 'Cache-Control' => 'no-cache', 'X-Accel-Buffering' => 'no'

	stream do |out|
		gone = false # the browser went away: stop writing, but let the caller finish its work
		emit = lambda do |event|
			next if gone
			data = event.to_json + "\n"
			begin
				out << "#{data.bytesize.to_s(16)}\r\n#{data}\r\n"
			rescue
				gone = true
			end
		end
		begin
			yield emit
		ensure
			(out << "0\r\n\r\n") rescue nil
		end
	end
end

def send_email(to, subj, html_body, opts = {})
  attachments = opts[:attachments].to_a
  email       = $emails_sent.add(to: to, subj: subj, html_body: html_body, opts: opts, res: EMAILS_ON ? 'sending' : 'unsent')
  
  if EMAILS_ON
    Thread.new {
      begin
        res = $postmark_client.deliver({from: opts[:from] || EMAILS_FROM,
        to: to,
        subject: subj,
        html_body: html_body,
        Attachments: attachments,     
        reply_to: opts[:reply_to], # optional
        track_opens: true,
        message_stream: opts[:message_stream] || 'broadcast'}.compact)
        $emails_sent.update_id(email[:_id], res: 'sent', postmark_id: (res[:message_id] rescue nil))
        puts "sent email: #{res}"
      rescue => e # surfaces on /admin/emails and /admin/errors
        $emails_sent.update_id(email[:_id], res: 'failed', error: e.to_s)
        log_e(e)
      end
    }
  else 
    puts "Skipping email subject: #{subj} because !EMAILS_ON".red    
  end

  email
rescue => e
  puts e.to_s.red
  log_e(e)
  false
end

def add_job(user)
	pr[:email]     = user[:email]
	pr[:type]      = JOB_TYPE
	data           = pr.just(:email, :title, :desc, :body, :type, *RICH_JOB_FIELDS.mapo(:k), :team_handles)
	data[:link]    = pr[:link] if pr[:link]
	if pr[:supratitle]
		data[:supratitle] = pr[:supratitle]
	else 
		data[:supratitle] = pr[:title]
	end

	data[:post_img_url] = pr[:post_body_img] if pr[:post_body_img].present?
	data[:user_id]    = user[:_id]
	data[:user_email] = pr[:email]
	data[:org_name]   = pr[:org_name]
	data[:cookies_user_id] = cookies[:cookies_user_id]
	data[:user]       = clean_user(user)
	# data[:img_url] = cu ? cu[:img_url] : nil
	# data[:location]= cu ? cu[:location] : nil
	# data[:website] = cu ? cu[:website] : nil
	data[:application_email_address] = pr[:application_email_address]

	new_job        = $jobs.add(data)

def send_email(to, subj, html_body, opts = {})
  attachments = opts[:attachments].to_a
  email       = $emails_sent.add(to: to, subj: subj, html_body: html_body, opts: opts, res: EMAILS_ON ? 'sending' : 'unsent')
  
  if EMAILS_ON
    Thread.new {
      begin
        res = $postmark_client.deliver({from: opts[:from] || EMAILS_FROM,
        to: to,
        subject: subj,
        html_body: html_body,
        Attachments: attachments,     
        reply_to: opts[:reply_to], # optional
        track_opens: true,
        message_stream: opts[:message_stream] || 'broadcast'}.compact)
        $emails_sent.update_id(email[:_id], res: 'sent', postmark_id: (res[:message_id] rescue nil))
        puts "sent email: #{res}"
      rescue => e # surfaces on /admin/emails and /admin/errors
        $emails_sent.update_id(email[:_id], res: 'failed', error: e.to_s)
        log_e(e)
      end
    }
  else 
    puts "Skipping email subject: #{subj} because !EMAILS_ON".red    
  end

  email
rescue => e
  puts e.to_s.red
  log_e(e)
  false
end

sources.code:
def send_email(to, subj, html_body, opts = {})
  attachments = opts[:attachments].to_a
  email       = $emails_sent.add(to: to, subj: subj, html_body: html_body, opts: opts, res: EMAILS_ON ? 'sending' : 'unsent')
  
  if EMAILS_ON
    Thread.new {
      begin
        res = $postmark_client.deliver({from: opts[:from] || EMAILS_FROM,
        to: to,
        subject: subj,
        html_body: html_body,
        Attachments: attachments,     
        reply_to: opts[:reply_to], # optional
        track_opens: true,
        message_stream: opts[:message_stream] || 'broadcast'}.compact)
        $emails_sent.update_id(email[:_id], res: 'sent', postmark_id: (res[:message_id] rescue nil))
        puts "sent email: #{res}"
      rescue => e # surfaces on /admin/emails and /admin/errors
        $emails_sent.update_id(email[:_id], res: 'failed', error: e.to_s)
        log_e(e)
      end
    }
  else 
    puts "Skipping email subject: #{subj} because !EMAILS_ON".red    
  end

  email
rescue => e
  puts e.to_s.red
  log_e(e)
  false
end

sources.code:
def send_email(to, subj, html_body, opts = {})
  attachments = opts[:attachments].to_a
  email       = $emails_sent.add(to: to, subj: subj, html_body: html_body, opts: opts, res: EMAILS_ON ? 'sending' : 'unsent')
  
  if EMAILS_ON
    Thread.new {
      begin
        res = $postmark_client.deliver({from: opts[:from] || EMAILS_FROM,
        to: to,
        subject: subj,
        html_body: html_body,
        Attachments: attachments,     
        reply_to: opts[:reply_to], # optional
        track_opens: true,
        message_stream: opts[:message_stream] || 'broadcast'}.compact)
        $emails_sent.update_id(email[:_id], res: 'sent', postmark_id: (res[:message_id] rescue nil))
        puts "sent email: #{res}"
      rescue => e # surfaces on /admin/emails and /admin/errors
        $emails_sent.update_id(email[:_id], res: 'failed', error: e.to_s)
        log_e(e)
      end
    }
  else 
    puts "Skipping email subject: #{subj} because !EMAILS_ON".red    
  end

  email
rescue => e
  puts e.to_s.red
  log_e(e)
  false
end

		send_email(email, "We listed your job on indydevs: #{pr[:supratitle]}", email_by_view('we_added_your_job', pr))  
	}
		
	session[:new_job] = job.to_json
	redirect back

		send_email('kfir@indydevs.com', "New post #{pr[:type]}: #{new_job.to_s}", new_job.to_s) rescue nil

def just(firstItem, *args) 
    # this method removes keys with empty values. Consider using just_keys instead.
    args = (firstItem.is_a? Array) ? firstItem : args.unshift(firstItem)

    args = (args.map {|v| v.to_s}) + (args.map {|v| v.to_sym})
    self.slice(*args).compact.hwia

def log_e(err, data = {})

    err = {msg: err} unless err.is_a? Hash
    err[:user_id]  = cuid rescue 'nil'

    err[:path]     = request_path rescue 'no-path'

def send_email(to, subj, html_body, opts = {})
  attachments = opts[:attachments].to_a
  email       = $emails_sent.add(to: to, subj: subj, html_body: html_body, opts: opts, res: EMAILS_ON ? 'sending' : 'unsent')
  
  if EMAILS_ON

sources.label: ai_find_agent_chat
sources.code:
def ai_find_agent_chat(user_id, key)
	agent = key == AI_DEFAULT_AGENT ? {'$in' => [key, nil]} : key # chats from before agents existed are Indy's
	chat, *rest = $ai_chats.find({user_id: user_id, agent: agent}, sort: {created_at: 1}).to_a
	return nil unless chat
	if rest.any?
		$ai_msgs.update_many({chat_id: {'$in' => rest.map {|c| c[:_id] }}}, {'$set' => {chat_id: chat[:_id]}})
		$ai_chats.delete_many(_id: {'$in' => rest.map {|c| c[:_id] }})
	end
	if rest.any? || chat[:agent] != key || chat[:seen_at].nil? # an old chat: what's in it counts as seen
		chat = $ai_chats.update_id(chat[:_id], {agent: key, title: "Chat with #{AI_AGENTS[key][:name]}", seen_at: chat[:seen_at] || Time.now})
	end
	chat
end

post '/pablo/msgs' do
	require_user_ajax
	me       = cu
	text     = pr[:text].to_s.strip[0, AI_MAX_MSG_CHARS]
	platform = pablo_platform(pr[:platform])
	halt_bad_input(msg: 'Empty message.') unless text.present?
	halt(429, {msg: "You're sending messages very fast - give it a few minutes and try again."}) if ai_rate_limited?(me[:_id])

	chat     = ai_open_agent_chat(me[:_id], PABLO_KEY)
	user_msg = $ai_msgs.add(chat_id: chat[:_id], user_id: me[:_id], role: 'user', text: text, platform: platform, sender: pablo_user_address(me, platform))
	$ai_chats.update_id(chat[:_id], {})
	style    = "This latest message came in on #{PABLO_PLATFORMS[platform][:label]}. #{PABLO_PLATFORM_STYLE[platform]}"
	ai_stream_reply(chat, me, user_msg, pablo_messages(chat, me, platform), platform: platform, sender: PABLO_PLATFORMS[platform][:address]) do |saved|
		status = pablo_deliver(saved, me)
		status && {delivery: status}
	end
end

def pablo_user_address(user, platform)

		when 'web'      then user[:name] || user[:handle]
		when 'whatsapp' then user[:whatsapp]

	CGI.unescapeHTML(val.to_s).squish.presence # user fields are stored html-escaped
end

def ai_stream_reply(chat, me, user_msg, messages, reply_fields = {}, &on_saved)
	agent = ai_chat_agent(chat)
	ai_stream_events do |emit|
		reply = +''
		error = nil
		begin
			emit.(type: 'start', at: user_msg[:created_at].iso8601(3))
			$ai_openai.chat(parameters: {
				model:    AI_MODEL,
				messages: messages,
				max_tokens: AI_MAX_REPLY_TOKENS,
				stream:   proc do |chunk, _bytesize|
					delta = chunk.dig('choices', 0, 'delta', 'content')
					next if delta.nil? || delta.empty? # not .present? - a delta is often just "\n" or " "
					reply << delta
					emit.(type: 'delta', text: delta)
				end
			})
			error = 'No reply came back - please try again.' if reply.empty?
		rescue => e
			log_e(e)
			error = $prod ? 'Sorry, something went wrong. Please try again.' : "AI error: #{e.message}"
		end

		if reply.present? # keep whatever was generated, also when an error cut it short
			saved = $ai_msgs.add(reply_fields.merge(chat_id: chat[:_id], role: 'assistant', text: reply, model: AI_MODEL))
			$ai_chats.update_id(chat[:_id], {})
			Thread.new { paamonim_update_family(me[:_id]) } if agent[:family_file]
			extra = (on_saved.call(saved) rescue log_e($!)) if on_saved
		else # nothing came back: don't leave an unanswered msg in the history (the browser hands the text back for a resend)
			$ai_msgs.delete_one(_id: user_msg[:_id])
		end
		# sent only once the reply is saved, so the browser's "seen" can't land before it
		emit.(error ? {type: 'error', msg: error, retry: reply.empty?} : {type: 'done', at: saved[:created_at].iso8601(3)}.merge(extra.is_a?(Hash) ? extra : {}))
	end
end

def ai_stream_events
	content_type 'application/x-ndjson'
	headers 'Transfer-Encoding' => 'chunked', 'Cache-Control' => 'no-cache', 'X-Accel-Buffering' => 'no'

	stream do |out|
		gone = false # the browser went away: stop writing, but let the caller finish its work
		emit = lambda do |event|
			next if gone
			data = event.to_json + "\n"
			begin
				out << "#{data.bytesize.to_s(16)}\r\n#{data}\r\n"
			rescue
				gone = true
			end
		end
		begin
			yield emit
		ensure
			(out << "0\r\n\r\n") rescue nil
		end
	end
end

    err = {msg: err} unless err.is_a? Hash
    err[:user_id]  = cuid rescue 'nil'

    $errors.add(err)
  rescue => e
    puts e
  end

def paamonim_update_family(user_id)
	$paamonim_family_lock.synchronize do
		chats = paamonim_family_chats(user_id)
		msgs  = paamonim_family_msgs(user_id, chats)
		next if msgs.empty?

		user = $users.get(user_id) || {}
		base = {
			user_id:      user_id,
			email:        user[:email],
			account_name: CGI.unescapeHTML((user[:name] || user[:handle]).to_s).squish.presence,
			chats_count:  chats.count,
			msgs_count:   msgs.count,
			last_msg_at:  msgs.last[:created_at],
		}
		family = $paamonim_families.get(user_id)
		family = family ? $paamonim_families.update_id(user_id, base) : $paamonim_families.add(base.merge(_id: user_id))

		current = PAAMONIM_FIELDS.keys.to_h {|k| [k, family[k]] }
		current.merge!(attention_resolved_at: family[:attention_resolved_at], last_attention_reason: family[:last_attention_reason]) if family[:attention_resolved_at]
		lines = msgs.last(PAAMONIM_TRANSCRIPT_MSGS).map do |m|
			"[#{m[:created_at].strftime('%Y-%m-%d %H:%M')}] #{m[:role] == 'user' ? 'family' : 'assistant'}: #{m[:text].to_s[0, 2000]}"
		end

		res = $ai_openai.chat(parameters: {
			model:           AI_MODEL,
			response_format: {type: 'json_object'},
			temperature:     0.2,
			max_tokens:      1500,
			messages: [
				{role: 'system', content: PAAMONIM_FAMILY_PROMPT},
				{role: 'user',   content: "Current file:\n#{current.to_json}\n\nConversation, oldest first:\n\n#{lines.join("\n\n")}"},
			]
		})
		fields = paamonim_clean_file(JSON.parse(res.dig('choices', 0, 'message', 'content').to_s)) rescue nil
		next unless fields

		fields[:attention_reason] = nil unless fields[:needs_attention]
		fields[:attention_at]     = Time.now if fields[:needs_attention] && !family[:needs_attention] # newly flagged
		$paamonim_families.update_id(user_id, fields.merge(ai_updated_at: Time.now, model: AI_MODEL))
	end
rescue => e
	log_e(e)
end

def paamonim_clean_file(raw)
	raw = {} unless raw.is_a?(Hash)
	str = ->(v, max) { (v.is_a?(String) || v.is_a?(Numeric)) ? v.to_s.squish[0, max].presence : nil }
	int = ->(v) { s = v.to_s.delete(',₪ ').strip; s =~ /\A-?\d+(\.\d+)?\z/ ? s.to_f.round : nil }
	PAAMONIM_FIELDS.to_h do |key, type|
		v = raw[key.to_s]
		val = case type
			when :str   then str.(v, 600)
			when :int   then int.(v)
			when :ints  then Array(v).map {|x| int.(x) }.compact.first(20)
			when :list  then Array(v).map {|x| str.(x, 200) }.compact.first(15)
			when :bool  then v == true || v.to_s == 'true'
			when Array  then type.include?(v.to_s) ? v.to_s : type.first
		end
		[key, val]
	end
end

def ai_build_messages(chat, me)
	name    = CGI.unescapeHTML((me[:name] || me[:handle]).to_s).squish # user fields are stored html-escaped
	agent   = ai_chat_agent(chat)
	system  = agent[:prompt] + (name.present? ? "\nThe user's name is #{name}.\n" : '')
	system += paamonim_family_context(me[:_id]) if agent[:family_file]
	history = ai_chat_msgs(chat[:_id]).last(AI_MAX_CONTEXT_MSGS).map {|msg| {role: msg[:role].to_s, content: msg[:text].to_s} }
	[{role: 'system', content: system}] + history
end

def pablo_deliver_whatsapp(msg, user)
	to = pablo_phone_digits(pablo_user_address(user, 'whatsapp'))
	return 'failed: there is no WhatsApp number on your profile' unless to
	return 'off' unless pablo_whatsapp_on?
	client = Twilio::REST::Client.new(ENV['TWILIO_ACCOUNT'], ENV['TWILIO_TOKEN'])
	from   = "whatsapp:+#{pablo_phone_digits(PABLO_PLATFORMS['whatsapp'][:address])}"
	opts   = $prod ? {status_callback: "#{$prod_url}/pablo/inbound/whatsapp_status?msg_id=#{msg[:_id]}"} : {}
	pablo_chunks(pablo_whatsapp_text(msg[:text]), PABLO_WA_MAX_CHARS).each do |part|
		client.messages.create(from: from, to: "whatsapp:+#{to}", body: part, **opts)
	end
	'sent'
rescue => e
	log_e(e)
	"failed: #{pablo_twilio_error(e.respond_to?(:code) && e.code, e.message)}"
end

def pablo_phone_digits(str)
	d = str.to_s.sub(/\Awhatsapp:/, '').gsub(/\D/, '').sub(/\A00/, '')
	d = '972' + d[1..] if d.start_with?('0')
	d.size >= 8 ? d : nil
end

def pablo_chunks(text, max)
	text.split(/\n{2,}/).each_with_object(['']) do |para, parts|
		para.scan(/.{1,#{max}}/m).each do |piece|
			joined = parts.last.empty? ? piece : "#{parts.last}\n\n#{piece}"
			joined.size > max ? parts << piece : parts[-1] = joined
		end
	end.reject(&:empty?)
end

def pablo_twilio_error(code, fallback = nil)
	case code.to_i
	when 63016 then 'WhatsApp only lets Pablo write to you within 24 hours of your last WhatsApp to him - send him a WhatsApp first'
	when 63003, 21211 then 'that WhatsApp number looks wrong - check it on your profile'
	else fallback.presence || 'WhatsApp did not take the message'
	end
end

def pablo_deliver_email(msg, user)
	to = pablo_user_address(user, 'email')
	return 'failed: there is no email address on your profile' unless to
	return 'off' unless EMAILS_ON
	sent = send_email(to, pablo_email_subject(msg[:chat_id]), pablo_email_html(msg[:text]),
		from: "Pablo <#{PABLO_PLATFORMS['email'][:address]}>", reply_to: PABLO_INBOUND_EMAIL, message_stream: 'outbound') # 'outbound': Postmark's 1:1 stream
	sent ? 'sent' : 'failed: the email could not be sent'
end

def send_email(to, subj, html_body, opts = {})
  attachments = opts[:attachments].to_a
  email       = $emails_sent.add(to: to, subj: subj, html_body: html_body, opts: opts, res: EMAILS_ON ? 'sending' : 'unsent')
  
  if EMAILS_ON
    Thread.new {
      begin
        res = $postmark_client.deliver({from: opts[:from] || EMAILS_FROM,
        to: to,
        subject: subj,
        html_body: html_body,
        Attachments: attachments,     
        reply_to: opts[:reply_to], # optional
        track_opens: true,
        message_stream: opts[:message_stream] || 'broadcast'}.compact)
        $emails_sent.update_id(email[:_id], res: 'sent', postmark_id: (res[:message_id] rescue nil))
        puts "sent email: #{res}"
      rescue => e # surfaces on /admin/emails and /admin/errors
        $emails_sent.update_id(email[:_id], res: 'failed', error: e.to_s)
        log_e(e)
      end
    }
  else 
    puts "Skipping email subject: #{subj} because !EMAILS_ON".red    
  end

  email
rescue => e
  puts e.to_s.red
  log_e(e)
  false
end

	halt(403, {msg: 'Bad signature.'}) unless pablo_twilio_request?
	digits = pablo_phone_digits(params['From'])
	user   = pablo_user_by_phone(digits)

	return pablo_twiml("I can only read text for now - could you type that out for me?") if params['Body'].to_s.strip.empty?

	pablo_twiml
end

def pablo_user_by_phone(digits)
	return nil unless digits
	match = $users.find({whatsapp: {'$nin' => [nil, '']}}, projection: {_id: 1, whatsapp: 1}).detect do |u|

def pablo_receive(user, platform, text, sender, extra = {})
	text = text.to_s.strip[0, AI_MAX_MSG_CHARS]
	return if text.empty?
	return log_e(StandardError.new("pablo: #{user[:_id]} is rate limited, dropped a #{platform} msg")) if ai_rate_limited?(user[:_id])
	chat = ai_open_agent_chat(user[:_id], PABLO_KEY)
	$ai_msgs.add(extra.merge(chat_id: chat[:_id], user_id: user[:_id], role: 'user', text: text, platform: platform, sender: sender))
	$ai_chats.update_id(chat[:_id], {})
	res   = $ai_openai.chat(parameters: {model: AI_MODEL, messages: pablo_messages(chat, user, platform), max_tokens: AI_MAX_REPLY_TOKENS})
	reply = res.dig('choices', 0, 'message', 'content').to_s.strip
	return if reply.empty?
	saved = $ai_msgs.add(chat_id: chat[:_id], role: 'assistant', text: reply, model: AI_MODEL, platform: platform, sender: PABLO_PLATFORMS[platform][:address])
	$ai_chats.update_id(chat[:_id], {})
	pablo_deliver(saved, user)
rescue => e
	log_e(e)
end

sources.code:
def ai_find_agent_chat(user_id, key)
	agent = key == AI_DEFAULT_AGENT ? {'$in' => [key, nil]} : key # chats from before agents existed are Indy's
	chat, *rest = $ai_chats.find({user_id: user_id, agent: agent}, sort: {created_at: 1}).to_a
	return nil unless chat
	if rest.any?
		$ai_msgs.update_many({chat_id: {'$in' => rest.map {|c| c[:_id] }}}, {'$set' => {chat_id: chat[:_id]}})
		$ai_chats.delete_many(_id: {'$in' => rest.map {|c| c[:_id] }})
	end
	if rest.any? || chat[:agent] != key || chat[:seen_at].nil? # an old chat: what's in it counts as seen
		chat = $ai_chats.update_id(chat[:_id], {agent: key, title: "Chat with #{AI_AGENTS[key][:name]}", seen_at: chat[:seen_at] || Time.now})
	end
	chat
end

def pablo_chunks(text, max)
	text.split(/\n{2,}/).each_with_object(['']) do |para, parts|
		para.scan(/.{1,#{max}}/m).each do |piece|
			joined = parts.last.empty? ? piece : "#{parts.last}\n\n#{piece}"
			joined.size > max ? parts << piece : parts[-1] = joined
		end
	end.reject(&:empty?)
end

def pablo_twilio_error(code, fallback = nil)
	case code.to_i
	when 63016 then 'WhatsApp only lets Pablo write to you within 24 hours of your last WhatsApp to him - send him a WhatsApp first'
	when 63003, 21211 then 'that WhatsApp number looks wrong - check it on your profile'
	else fallback.presence || 'WhatsApp did not take the message'
	end
end

def pablo_deliver_email(msg, user)
	to = pablo_user_address(user, 'email')
	return 'failed: there is no email address on your profile' unless to
	return 'off' unless EMAILS_ON
	sent = send_email(to, pablo_email_subject(msg[:chat_id]), pablo_email_html(msg[:text]),
		from: "Pablo <#{PABLO_PLATFORMS['email'][:address]}>", reply_to: PABLO_INBOUND_EMAIL, message_stream: 'outbound') # 'outbound': Postmark's 1:1 stream
	sent ? 'sent' : 'failed: the email could not be sent'
end

def send_email(to, subj, html_body, opts = {})
  attachments = opts[:attachments].to_a
  email       = $emails_sent.add(to: to, subj: subj, html_body: html_body, opts: opts, res: EMAILS_ON ? 'sending' : 'unsent')
  
  if EMAILS_ON
    Thread.new {
      begin
        res = $postmark_client.deliver({from: opts[:from] || EMAILS_FROM,
        to: to,
        subject: subj,
        html_body: html_body,
        Attachments: attachments,     
        reply_to: opts[:reply_to], # optional
        track_opens: true,
        message_stream: opts[:message_stream] || 'broadcast'}.compact)
        $emails_sent.update_id(email[:_id], res: 'sent', postmark_id: (res[:message_id] rescue nil))
        puts "sent email: #{res}"
      rescue => e # surfaces on /admin/emails and /admin/errors
        $emails_sent.update_id(email[:_id], res: 'failed', error: e.to_s)
        log_e(e)
      end
    }
  else 
    puts "Skipping email subject: #{subj} because !EMAILS_ON".red    
  end

  email
rescue => e
  puts e.to_s.red
  log_e(e)
  false
end

def pablo_receive(user, platform, text, sender, extra = {})
	text = text.to_s.strip[0, AI_MAX_MSG_CHARS]
	return if text.empty?
	return log_e(StandardError.new("pablo: #{user[:_id]} is rate limited, dropped a #{platform} msg")) if ai_rate_limited?(user[:_id])
	chat = ai_open_agent_chat(user[:_id], PABLO_KEY)
	$ai_msgs.add(extra.merge(chat_id: chat[:_id], user_id: user[:_id], role: 'user', text: text, platform: platform, sender: sender))
	$ai_chats.update_id(chat[:_id], {})
	res   = $ai_openai.chat(parameters: {model: AI_MODEL, messages: pablo_messages(chat, user, platform), max_tokens: AI_MAX_REPLY_TOKENS})
	reply = res.dig('choices', 0, 'message', 'content').to_s.strip
	return if reply.empty?
	saved = $ai_msgs.add(chat_id: chat[:_id], role: 'assistant', text: reply, model: AI_MODEL, platform: platform, sender: PABLO_PLATFORMS[platform][:address])
	$ai_chats.update_id(chat[:_id], {})
	pablo_deliver(saved, user)
rescue => e
	log_e(e)
end

def log_e(err, data = {})  
    err = {msg: err.to_s, backtrace: err.backtrace.to_a.slice(0,100)} if err.is_a? Exception
    err = {msg: err} unless err.is_a? Hash
    err[:user_id]  = cuid rescue 'nil'
    err[:email]    = cu[:email] rescue 'no-email'
    err[:path]     = request_path rescue 'no-path'
    err[:params]   = JSON.parse(_params.to_json) rescue {} #sometimes params has un-BSON able fields
    $errors.add(err)
  rescue => e
    puts e
  end

def ai_find_agent_chat(user_id, key)
	agent = key == AI_DEFAULT_AGENT ? {'$in' => [key, nil]} : key # chats from before agents existed are Indy's
	chat, *rest = $ai_chats.find({user_id: user_id, agent: agent}, sort: {created_at: 1}).to_a
	return nil unless chat
	if rest.any?
		$ai_msgs.update_many({chat_id: {'$in' => rest.map {|c| c[:_id] }}}, {'$set' => {chat_id: chat[:_id]}})
		$ai_chats.delete_many(_id: {'$in' => rest.map {|c| c[:_id] }})
	end
	if rest.any? || chat[:agent] != key || chat[:seen_at].nil? # an old chat: what's in it counts as seen
		chat = $ai_chats.update_id(chat[:_id], {agent: key, title: "Chat with #{AI_AGENTS[key][:name]}", seen_at: chat[:seen_at] || Time.now})
	end
	chat
end

def ai_build_messages(chat, me)
	name    = CGI.unescapeHTML((me[:name] || me[:handle]).to_s).squish # user fields are stored html-escaped
	agent   = ai_chat_agent(chat)
	system  = agent[:prompt] + (name.present? ? "\nThe user's name is #{name}.\n" : '')
	system += paamonim_family_context(me[:_id]) if agent[:family_file]
	history = ai_chat_msgs(chat[:_id]).last(AI_MAX_CONTEXT_MSGS).map {|msg| {role: msg[:role].to_s, content: msg[:text].to_s} }
	[{role: 'system', content: system}] + history
end

		when 'whatsapp' then pablo_deliver_whatsapp(msg, user)

def pablo_deliver_whatsapp(msg, user)
	to = pablo_phone_digits(pablo_user_address(user, 'whatsapp'))
	return 'failed: there is no WhatsApp number on your profile' unless to
	return 'off' unless pablo_whatsapp_on?
	client = Twilio::REST::Client.new(ENV['TWILIO_ACCOUNT'], ENV['TWILIO_TOKEN'])
	from   = "whatsapp:+#{pablo_phone_digits(PABLO_PLATFORMS['whatsapp'][:address])}"
	opts   = $prod ? {status_callback: "#{$prod_url}/pablo/inbound/whatsapp_status?msg_id=#{msg[:_id]}"} : {}
	pablo_chunks(pablo_whatsapp_text(msg[:text]), PABLO_WA_MAX_CHARS).each do |part|
		client.messages.create(from: from, to: "whatsapp:+#{to}", body: part, **opts)
	end
	'sent'
rescue => e
	log_e(e)
	"failed: #{pablo_twilio_error(e.respond_to?(:code) && e.code, e.message)}"
end

def pablo_phone_digits(str)
	d = str.to_s.sub(/\Awhatsapp:/, '').gsub(/\D/, '').sub(/\A00/, '')
	d = '972' + d[1..] if d.start_with?('0')
	d.size >= 8 ? d : nil
end

def pablo_chunks(text, max)
	text.split(/\n{2,}/).each_with_object(['']) do |para, parts|
		para.scan(/.{1,#{max}}/m).each do |piece|
			joined = parts.last.empty? ? piece : "#{parts.last}\n\n#{piece}"
			joined.size > max ? parts << piece : parts[-1] = joined
		end
	end.reject(&:empty?)
end

def pablo_deliver_email(msg, user)
	to = pablo_user_address(user, 'email')
	return 'failed: there is no email address on your profile' unless to
	return 'off' unless EMAILS_ON
	sent = send_email(to, pablo_email_subject(msg[:chat_id]), pablo_email_html(msg[:text]),
		from: "Pablo <#{PABLO_PLATFORMS['email'][:address]}>", reply_to: PABLO_INBOUND_EMAIL, message_stream: 'outbound') # 'outbound': Postmark's 1:1 stream
	sent ? 'sent' : 'failed: the email could not be sent'
end

def send_email(to, subj, html_body, opts = {})
  attachments = opts[:attachments].to_a
  email       = $emails_sent.add(to: to, subj: subj, html_body: html_body, opts: opts, res: EMAILS_ON ? 'sending' : 'unsent')
  
  if EMAILS_ON
    Thread.new {
      begin
        res = $postmark_client.deliver({from: opts[:from] || EMAILS_FROM,
        to: to,
        subject: subj,
        html_body: html_body,
        Attachments: attachments,     
        reply_to: opts[:reply_to], # optional
        track_opens: true,
        message_stream: opts[:message_stream] || 'broadcast'}.compact)
        $emails_sent.update_id(email[:_id], res: 'sent', postmark_id: (res[:message_id] rescue nil))
        puts "sent email: #{res}"
      rescue => e # surfaces on /admin/emails and /admin/errors
        $emails_sent.update_id(email[:_id], res: 'failed', error: e.to_s)
        log_e(e)
      end
    }
  else 
    puts "Skipping email subject: #{subj} because !EMAILS_ON".red    
  end

  email
rescue => e
  puts e.to_s.red
  log_e(e)
  false
end

sources.label: send_email
sources.code:
def send_email(to, subj, html_body, opts = {})
  attachments = opts[:attachments].to_a
  email       = $emails_sent.add(to: to, subj: subj, html_body: html_body, opts: opts, res: EMAILS_ON ? 'sending' : 'unsent')
  
  if EMAILS_ON
    Thread.new {
      begin
        res = $postmark_client.deliver({from: opts[:from] || EMAILS_FROM,
        to: to,
        subject: subj,
        html_body: html_body,
        Attachments: attachments,     
        reply_to: opts[:reply_to], # optional
        track_opens: true,
        message_stream: opts[:message_stream] || 'broadcast'}.compact)
        $emails_sent.update_id(email[:_id], res: 'sent', postmark_id: (res[:message_id] rescue nil))
        puts "sent email: #{res}"
      rescue => e # surfaces on /admin/emails and /admin/errors
        $emails_sent.update_id(email[:_id], res: 'failed', error: e.to_s)
        log_e(e)
      end
    }
  else 
    puts "Skipping email subject: #{subj} because !EMAILS_ON".red    
  end

  email
rescue => e
  puts e.to_s.red
  log_e(e)
  false
end

    return nil unless res
    {_id: _id}.merge(res).hwia
  end

    err[:params]   = JSON.parse(_params.to_json) rescue {} #sometimes params has un-BSON able fields
    $errors.add(err)
  rescue => e
    puts e
  end

post '/stripe/pay' do	
  data    = pr
  cast_id = pr[:cast_id]
  cast    = $casts.get(cast_id)
  is_trial= is_series(cast)
  amount  = cast[:cost_dollars].to_i * 100

  if cast_allows_variable_amount(cast) && pr[:variable_amount].to_i > 0
  	amount = pr[:variable_amount].to_i * 100 
  end

  begin
    if data['payment_method_id']
      # Create the PaymentIntent

      payload = {
        payment_method: data['payment_method_id'],
        amount: amount,
        metadata: {nowcast_seller_id: cast[:user_id], nowcast_cast_id: cast_id, nowcast_buyer_id: cuid},
        currency: 'usd',
        confirmation_method: 'manual',
        confirm: true,
      }

      opts = {}
    	opts[:api_key] = SECRET_STAGING_KEY if is_test_buy(cast)

			intent = Stripe::PaymentIntent.create(payload, opts)
    elsif data['payment_intent_id']
      intent = Stripe::PaymentIntent.confirm(data['payment_intent_id'])
      x=1
    end
  rescue Stripe::CardError => e
    # Display error on client
    return [200, { error: e.message }.to_json]
  end

  if (intent.status == 'succeeded') 
  	enroll_user(cuid, cast_id, {amount: amount, intent_id: intent.id, is_trial: is_trial, expires_at: Time.now + 1.week - 1.hour})
  	$single_payments.add({user_id: cuid, cast_id: cast_id, amount_cents: intent.amount, intent_id: intent.id})
  end

  return generate_response(intent)

def send_email(to, subj, html_body, opts = {})
  attachments = opts[:attachments].to_a
  email       = $emails_sent.add(to: to, subj: subj, html_body: html_body, opts: opts, res: EMAILS_ON ? 'sending' : 'unsent')
  
  if EMAILS_ON
    Thread.new {
      begin
        res = $postmark_client.deliver({from: opts[:from] || EMAILS_FROM,
        to: to,
        subject: subj,
        html_body: html_body,
        Attachments: attachments,     
        reply_to: opts[:reply_to], # optional
        track_opens: true,
        message_stream: opts[:message_stream] || 'broadcast'}.compact)
        $emails_sent.update_id(email[:_id], res: 'sent', postmark_id: (res[:message_id] rescue nil))
        puts "sent email: #{res}"
      rescue => e # surfaces on /admin/emails and /admin/errors
        $emails_sent.update_id(email[:_id], res: 'failed', error: e.to_s)
        log_e(e)
      end
    }
  else 
    puts "Skipping email subject: #{subj} because !EMAILS_ON".red    
  end

  email
rescue => e
  puts e.to_s.red
  log_e(e)
  false
end

def generate_response(intent)
  if intent.status == 'requires_action' &&
    intent.next_action.type == 'use_stripe_sdk' # Tell the client to handle the action
    [200,{requires_action: true, payment_intent_client_secret: intent.client_secret}.to_json ]
  elsif intent.status == 'succeeded'
    # The payment didn’t need any additional actions and is completed! Handle post-payment fulfillment
    [200, {success: true}.to_json]
  else # Invalid status
    return [500, { error: 'Invalid PaymentIntent status' }.to_json]
  end
end

post '/stripe/subscribe' do 		
	cast_id = pr[:cast_id]
	email   = cu[:email] #pr[:email]

	halt(401,{err: 'Missing cast_id'}) unless cast_id && (cast = $casts.get(cast_id))

	test_buy = is_test_buy(cast)
	
	opts = {}
	opts[:api_key] = SECRET_STAGING_KEY if test_buy

	#1. Create stripe customer
	customer = Stripe::Customer.create({
	  payment_method: pr[:payment_method],
	  email: email,	  
	  invoice_settings: {
	    default_payment_method: pr[:payment_method],
	  }}, opts
	)
	
	customer_obj = JSON.parse(customer.to_json).hwia
	$stripe_customers.add(customer_obj)

	#2. Create subscription
  # check plans
	plan_id             = ($prod && !test_buy) ? 'plan_HDvrZH7PrxAGUL' : 'plan_HDwq4xzL6MY27A'
	start_of_next_month = Date.today.at_beginning_of_month.next_month.to_datetime.to_i

	quantity            = cast[:cost_dollars].to_i

	if cast_allows_variable_amount(cast) && pr[:variable_amount].to_i > MIN_VARIABLE_AMOUNT
  	quantity = pr[:variable_amount].to_i
  end

  payload = {
		customer: customer.id,
	  items: [
      #plan is 1 USD a month, quantity raises it to actual amount
	  	{plan: plan_id, quantity: quantity}
	  ],

		# TODO start of next
	  #billing_cycle_anchor: start_of_next_month,
	  metadata: {nowcast_seller_id: cast[:user_id],
               nowcast_cast_id: cast_id,
               nowcast_buyer_id: cuid},
	  expand: ['latest_invoice.payment_intent']
	}
	
	subscription        = Stripe::Subscription.create(payload, opts)
	#3. Store subscription
	sub                 = JSON.parse(subscription.to_json).hwia	
	sub[:_id]           = sub[:id]
	sub[:user_id]       = cuid
	sub[:cast_id]       = cast_id
	sub[:cast_user_id]  = cast[:user_id]
	sub[:plan_amount]   = sub[:plan][:amount]

	added_sub = $subs.add(sub)

	paid_amount = added_sub[:latest_invoice][:amount_paid].to_i 
	enroll_user(cuid, cast_id, {sub_id: added_sub[:_id], amount: paid_amount})

	{msg: "ok"}
end

def send_email(to, subj, html_body, opts = {})
  attachments = opts[:attachments].to_a
  email       = $emails_sent.add(to: to, subj: subj, html_body: html_body, opts: opts, res: EMAILS_ON ? 'sending' : 'unsent')
  
  if EMAILS_ON
    Thread.new {
      begin
        res = $postmark_client.deliver({from: opts[:from] || EMAILS_FROM,
        to: to,
        subject: subj,
        html_body: html_body,
        Attachments: attachments,     
        reply_to: opts[:reply_to], # optional
        track_opens: true,
        message_stream: opts[:message_stream] || 'broadcast'}.compact)
        $emails_sent.update_id(email[:_id], res: 'sent', postmark_id: (res[:message_id] rescue nil))
        puts "sent email: #{res}"
      rescue => e # surfaces on /admin/emails and /admin/errors
        $emails_sent.update_id(email[:_id], res: 'failed', error: e.to_s)
        log_e(e)
      end
    }
  else 
    puts "Skipping email subject: #{subj} because !EMAILS_ON".red    
  end

  email
rescue => e
  puts e.to_s.red
  log_e(e)
  false
end

def stripe_charges_for_seller(seller_id = nil, opts = {})
	puts "Loading stripe charges for #{seller_id}...".green

	cur_month = !opts[:last_month]
	time      = cur_month ? Date.today.at_beginning_of_month.to_datetime.to_i : Date.today.at_beginning_of_month.prev_month.to_datetime.to_i
	time      = opts[:time].to_i if opts[:time].present?
	list      = Stripe::Charge.list({limit: 1000, created: {gt: time}})
	charges   = []

	list.auto_paging_each do |charge|
		# checking that it's not a subscription and it's a valid
		charge_belongs_to_seller = (charge[:metadata] || {})[:nowcast_seller_id] == seller_id
		charge_belongs_to_a_cast = !(charge[:metadata] || {})[:nowcast_cast_id].nil?
		# checking that it's not a subscription (handled separtly at stripe_sub_earnings)
		is_a_valid_charge = (!seller_id || charge_belongs_to_seller) & charge_belongs_to_a_cast

		if is_a_valid_charge
			charges.push(charge)
		end
	end

	clean_charges = charges.to_a.map  { |charge|
		data = {
			seller_id:   charge[:metadata][:nowcast_seller_id],
			buyer_id:    charge[:metadata][:nowcast_buyer_id],
			cast_id:     charge[:metadata][:nowcast_cast_id],
			created_at:  Time.at(charge[:created]),
			amount:      charge[:amount]
		}
		data
	}

	{orig: charges, clean: clean_charges}
end

def stripe_sub_earnings(seller_id = nil, opts = {})
	puts "Loading stripe subscription earnings for #{seller_id}...".green

	cur_month = !opts[:last_month]
	time      = cur_month ? Date.today.at_beginning_of_month.to_datetime.to_i : Date.today.at_beginning_of_month.prev_month.to_datetime.to_i
	time      = opts[:time].to_i if opts[:time].present?
	subs      = Stripe::Subscription.list({limit: 1000, status: 'active', current_period_start: {gt: time}})
	
	seller_subs = subs[:data].select {|sub| !seller_id || (sub[:metadata] || {})[:nowcast_seller_id] == seller_id }

	seller_subs_clean = seller_subs.map {|sub| 
		data = {
			buyer_email: sub[:email],
			seller_id:   sub[:metadata][:nowcast_seller_id],
			buyer_id:    sub[:metadata][:nowcast_buyer_id],
			cast_id:     sub[:metadata][:nowcast_cast_id],
			created_at:  Time.at(sub[:created]),
			amount:      sub[:items][:data][0][:quantity] * 100
		}
	}

	{orig: seller_subs, clean: seller_subs_clean}
end

def send_email(to, subj, html_body, opts = {})
  attachments = opts[:attachments].to_a
  email       = $emails_sent.add(to: to, subj: subj, html_body: html_body, opts: opts, res: EMAILS_ON ? 'sending' : 'unsent')
  
  if EMAILS_ON
    Thread.new {
      begin
        res = $postmark_client.deliver({from: opts[:from] || EMAILS_FROM,
        to: to,
        subject: subj,
        html_body: html_body,
        Attachments: attachments,     
        reply_to: opts[:reply_to], # optional
        track_opens: true,
        message_stream: opts[:message_stream] || 'broadcast'}.compact)
        $emails_sent.update_id(email[:_id], res: 'sent', postmark_id: (res[:message_id] rescue nil))
        puts "sent email: #{res}"
      rescue => e # surfaces on /admin/emails and /admin/errors
        $emails_sent.update_id(email[:_id], res: 'failed', error: e.to_s)
        log_e(e)
      end
    }
  else 
    puts "Skipping email subject: #{subj} because !EMAILS_ON".red    
  end

  email
rescue => e
  puts e.to_s.red
  log_e(e)
  false
end

sources.code:
def send_email(to, subj, html_body, opts = {})
  attachments = opts[:attachments].to_a
  email       = $emails_sent.add(to: to, subj: subj, html_body: html_body, opts: opts, res: EMAILS_ON ? 'sending' : 'unsent')
  
  if EMAILS_ON
    Thread.new {
      begin
        res = $postmark_client.deliver({from: opts[:from] || EMAILS_FROM,
        to: to,
        subject: subj,
        html_body: html_body,
        Attachments: attachments,     
        reply_to: opts[:reply_to], # optional
        track_opens: true,
        message_stream: opts[:message_stream] || 'broadcast'}.compact)
        $emails_sent.update_id(email[:_id], res: 'sent', postmark_id: (res[:message_id] rescue nil))
        puts "sent email: #{res}"
      rescue => e # surfaces on /admin/emails and /admin/errors
        $emails_sent.update_id(email[:_id], res: 'failed', error: e.to_s)
        log_e(e)
      end
    }
  else 
    puts "Skipping email subject: #{subj} because !EMAILS_ON".red    
  end

  email
rescue => e
  puts e.to_s.red
  log_e(e)
  false
end

def send_email(to, subj, html_body, opts = {})
  attachments = opts[:attachments].to_a
  email       = $emails_sent.add(to: to, subj: subj, html_body: html_body, opts: opts, res: EMAILS_ON ? 'sending' : 'unsent')

        subject: subj,
        html_body: html_body,

      rescue => e # surfaces on /admin/emails and /admin/errors

    }

  end

  email
rescue => e

  false
end
